paragraphs: A fan experience for 9, FOLA's album (Dangbana Republik / EMPIRE, October 2026). Fans bring a case against someone in their life: a man, an ex, a bestie, a mum, the landlord, the tailor, even themselves, for treating them badly or for treating them right. The court asks who, the charge and what happened, all a tap away; an AI judge asks a question or two at most, roasts whoever's guilty, then the gavel comes down and the verdict is read out with a sentence, in a few punchy words made for posting. Every verdict goes on the plaintiff's court record, a card to post, however many cases they file.…
treat u right plays underneath the whole time.
The site is built to hold more activities later: the front page lists whatever is switched on in the admin.
